page_head.intro: NC Falcon was founded by the Falcon family in North Carolina, on more than 20 years of real electrical industry experience.

mission.title: Dependable manpower. Steady opportunity.
mission.lead: NC Falcon provides dependable electrical manpower solutions for contractors while creating consistent work opportunities for skilled electricians.
mission.lead_es: NC Falcon provides dependable electrical manpower solutions for contractors while creating consistent work opportunities for skilled electricians.
mission.text: As a family-owned business, we focus on relationships, communication, reliability, and flexibility. Our goal is simple: help contractors solve their manpower challenges while giving electricians the steady work and professional growth they deserve.
mission.text_es: As a family-owned business, we focus on relationships, communication, reliability, and flexibility. Our goal is simple: help contractors solve their manpower challenges while giving electricians the steady work and professional growth they deserve.

paragraphs.text: NC Falcon was founded by the Falcon family in North Carolina and built from real experience in the electrical industry.
paragraphs.text_es: NC Falcon was founded by the Falcon family in North Carolina and built from real experience in the electrical industry.

paragraphs.text: Ownership brings more than 20 years of electrical experience, while the next generation continues to grow the business through recruiting, contractor relationships, and workforce development.
paragraphs.text_es: Ownership brings more than 20 years of electrical experience, while the next generation continues to grow the business through recruiting, contractor relationships, and workforce development.

paragraphs.text: We've placed more than 100 electricians over time and keep roughly 20 actively working. Most come to us through referrals, industry connections, and word of mouth.
